summary: Round-3 delta scan, 22:16-22:30 UTC 25 Sep, compared with round 2 (LB 19:46 UTC). Very little changed and nothing affects K2 at 00:01 UTC or the plan. The public LB now has 3,914 teams (was 3,908). We are rank 164 at 0.954 (was 157). The drop comes only from teams above us: 8 teams entered the 0.954+ range from below. Our place inside the 0.954 block is unchanged (18th of 65). Block counts, with 19:46 in brackets: 0.953 = 280 (268), 0.954 = 65 (63), 0.955 = 40 (38), 0.956 = 23 (21), 0.957 = 14 (13), >=0.960 = 49 (47), >=0.953 = 491 (469). Rank ranges: 0.954 = 147-211, 0.953 = 212-491. The silver line (about rank 196) is still inside the 0.954 block, 32 ranks below us. The top 19 did not change. Syed Asad Ali jumped from 0.953 (#417) to 0.965 (#20). His only public kernels are for another competition. Sixteen more teams moved from 0.947 into 0.953, all at the END of the 0.953 block, which again fits late x138 copies. No public notebook has run since raunakdey07 at 09:09 UTC, and none scores above 0.953. x138 is unchanged (Version 1 of 1, 3 comments; copies went from 258 to 260). The only discussion activity is a one-line comment by Gabriel (#1) on a beginner public/private-split thread, with no content. There are no host announcements and no changes to the Overview, timeline, runtime limit or data. Nothing was pulled into experiments/ext_*.
